commits.message: fix(db): enforce authoritative BIDFAST record timestamps

confirmed_gap.name: client_controlled_workflow_timestamps
confirmed_gap.description: Multiple implemented BIDFAST workflow clients submit local-clock updated_at values while the prior general schema did not universally override created_at and updated_at at the authoritative database boundary.

candidate_controls: Database-owned created_at on insert for BIDFAST accounts, organizations, opportunities, projects, documents, takeoffs, estimates, proposals, and approvals.
Immutable created_at on update for the same records.
Database-owned updated_at on insert and update using statement_timestamp().
Trigger function execution revoked from public, anon, and authenticated roles and granted only to service_role.
Governance checker registered in npm run governance and therefore in the preview build gate.
Explicit rollback instructions preserve immutable evidence before trigger removal.
blockers: Exact workflow timestamp provenance run and artifact are not visible through the first-page workflow fanout.
The active Supabase connector cannot access governed project mhaovpyegtysfgualplu.
The active Vercel connector cannot inspect deployments in strategic-minds-advisory, so underlying dpl identifiers and logs remain unavailable.
The migration has not been installed or tested in an isolated governed Supabase branch.
Timestamp injection, audit ordering, authorization, tenant isolation, rollback, and full Account to Audit workflow tests remain unexecuted.
No approved route has newly demonstrated 0.99 visual parity, and complete light/dark multi-viewport source coverage remains incomplete.

rollback.database: No database rollback is required because the migration was not applied.
